content.description: Leveraged yield farming and lending protocol on Base and Optimism. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Extra Finance provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on defi yield farming platforms. By operating on Base and OP Mainnet, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the DeFi Dapps sector. Through continuous innovation, Extra Finance contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
